notes:
Summary: Enterprise engineering org (platform + search teams) looking for high-quality code search and internal doc RAG. Primary constraint is IP sensitivity (internal code), frequent re-indexing cadence, and strict SSO + audit requirements.

Background / context:
- Company has ~2k engineers, monorepos + microservices. Heavy internal wikis, PR history, and code snapshots to index.
- Current solution: self-hosted vector DB + custom ANN; struggling at scale (50M+ embeddings) — slow cold-starts and high storage cost.
- Wants combined approach: ANN (HNSW/IVF) for top-k retrieval + lightweight cross-encoder reranker for precision on top 20. Prefer quantized vectors to reduce storage.
- Re-indexing: nightly full pass + near-real-time incremental for active repos. Need fast ingest pipeline (below 2 hours for nightly; <5 min for hot updates).

Requirements called out by Eng / SRE:
- Query SLO: median end-to-end (embed -> ANN -> rerank -> response) <= 150ms for standard DEV cluster queries; <100ms for cached/popular queries.
- Throughput target: 1k qps sustained for search API peaks with burst capacity to 5k qps.
- Cost sensitivity: upper bound target CPL (cost per lookup + rerank) ~$0.003-0.01 depending on k and reranker model.
- Storage target: 50M-200M embeddings; want fractional precision (8-bit/4-bit) to save on storage.
- Security: SSO/SAML, tenant-level audit logs, KMS integration, strict retention policy for indices, ability to deploy inside customer VPC or on-prem.

Recent timeline / activity:
- 2026-01-05: Intro call (owner Maya Chen). High-level requirements collected; legal introduced.
- 2026-01-18: Security questionnaire submitted (SEC-3098). Engineering attached sample threat model.
- 2026-01-26: Architecture review with SE (Diego) — sketched hybrid ANN + reranker flow; discussed quantization tradeoffs.
- 2026-02-02: Drive link shared with cost model template. Requested Redwood to fill with perf projections.
- 2026-02-14: Deep-dive with infra and search team (linked fireflies). Agreed on PoC scope: 2-week perf + cost PoC on dedicated capacity, ingest 10M sample embeddings, run stress tests.
- 2026-02-18: Legal follow-up on IP/data residency; raised blocker for EU corpus residency (needs confirmation).

PoC scope (agreed):
- Ingest 10M code/doc embeddings (customer sample corpus) into Redwood Dedicated pool.
- Implement hybrid retrieval: ANN for top-200 -> distilled cross-encoder reranker for top-20. Compare against baseline (current provider).
- Measure: p95 latency (embed + ann + rerank), qps, cost per 1M queries, storage delta with 8-bit quantization.
- Deliverables: perf matrix, cost projection, checklist for SAML + KMS integration, recommended rollout plan (canary -> global).

Open questions / risks:
- Which embedding model to standardize on? Customer prefers open-source models but wants Redwood to validate accuracy vs proprietary embeddings.
- Reranker budget: cross-encoder for every query is too expensive; need to validate top-N cutoff to hit cost target.
- Ingestion window for hot updates — can Redwood support <5 min upsert visibility across replicas?
- EU data residency: need confirmation if Dedicated in eu-west1 meets retention/residency requirements.

Sales tips / AE notes:
- Emphasize Redwood's hybrid routing and fallback to quantized model variants to save cost.
- Offer Optimize consult to tune batching and KV cache for code workloads (high prefix reuse).
- Bring up Dedicated + optional Private (VPC) for legal comfort — high chance to convert if PoC meets latency + security gates.
- Close blocker: get SAML metadata and legal IP template during PoC start.

Quotes from stakeholders:

- "We cannot have code vectors leave our VPC without special controls." — Security eng
